title: A null-calibrated spectral-memory benchmark for hydrological model timescale diagnostics
description: Software, derived non-sensitive source-data tables, deterministic figures, dataset registries, and runbooks supporting an ESSD data-description manuscript on a null-calibrated spectral-memory benchmark for hydrological model timescale diagnostics. The released decision test preserves its null result. Raw third-party datasets and submission manuscripts are not redistributed; official source links are listed in the dataset registry.
